subject: Request: Travel exception & early arrival for BrightPath onsite
messages:
From: Claire Hastings <chastings@brightpath.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onsite confirmation + travel exception request

Hi Neha & Rishi,

Thanks again — BrightPath is excited to host the workshop in Phoenix the week of Dec 8. A quick logistics flag: our CEO, David Lyle, has a recent medical recommendation to avoid multiple overnight flights in economy; he prefers business class on long legs (SFO-PHX return).

Can Redwood either: 1) approve a one-time business class upgrade for David, or 2) cover the incremental cost for the upgrade? Also we may need an extra hotel night (arriving evening Dec 7) which may affect per-diem/budget.

I've attached the agenda for the two-day onsite so you can see senior coverage. If helpful, I can provide David's doctor's note to your travel team.

Proposed attendees (BrightPath): David Lyle (CEO), Claire Hastings (Head of Product), Omar Ruiz (IT lead)

Please let me know what approval path you need on your side and any required forms. We'd like to finalize travel by EOD Monday (Nov 30).

Best,
Claire

Attachments: BP-onsite-agenda-2025-11-27.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hastings <chastings@brightpath.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2025 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite confirmation + travel exception request

Hi Claire — thanks for the flag and for sending the agenda. Welcome — excited to have BrightPath on-site.

Quick notes on process so we're aligned:
- Any exception to the travel policy (upgrades, extra nights) typically needs approval by Finance for budget and by a manager for precedent. I've looped in Lauren (Finance) and Marissa (Sales Ops) to run the numbers and start the approval flow.
- If David can share a brief medical note, that speeds approvals for an upgrade. If not, we can still review as a business-case exception given this is a strategic exec meeting on a sizable renewal (DEAL-9342-BP).
- Rishi — can you confirm Redwood headcount and whether we are covering any travel on our side? That will help total budget.

Targeting an answer by Monday morning.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Hastings <chastings@brightpath.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2025 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Onsite confirmation + travel exception request

Neha / team — reviewing per travel policy v3 (link below). Short summary and recommended path:

Summary:
- Policy: Business-class upgrades require VP-level pre-approval when requested for external execs; medical exceptions are considered but need either a physician note or a senior-approval memo.
- Cost: incremental one-way upgrade SFO-PHX (business on award fares) estimated at ~ $610; return slightly higher. Local hotel extra-night ~ $220. Total incremental cost estimate ~ $1,200. Attached is a quick estimate I pulled.

Recommendation:
1) Request a VP-level approval (Aditya Rao) for the business upgrade as a one-off strategic exception tied to renewal.
2) Redwood covers up to 50% of the incremental hotel extra-night; BrightPath covers remaining lodging unless the customer requests otherwise.
3) Require Concur request and receipts uploaded within 10 business days post-travel; mark cost to deal code DEAL-9342-BP for P&L attribution.

I've attached the estimate (travel-upgrade-estimate-2025-11-28.pdf) and added the travel-policy link for Claire's visibility. If Claire can supply a short medical attestation, that would simplify approval.

Links: https://redwood-internal.company.com/policies/travel-policy-v3.pdf

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Attachments: travel-upgrade-estimate-2025-11-28.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Nov 2025 09:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite confirmation + travel exception request

Thanks for the clear recommendation, Lauren. I approve a one-time exception for this onsite under the following conditions:

1) Business-class is approved for David Lyle on the long-haul segment only (SFO <-> PHX) where duration or medical note justifies it — book the lowest available business fare.
2) Redwood will cover the full incremental airfare for the business upgrade.
3) Redwood will cover 50% of the extra hotel night (up to $250).
4) Concur request must be submitted before tickets are purchased and receipts uploaded within 10 business days after travel. Mark expenses to deal code DEAL-9342-BP.
5) Require a short medical attestation (email or PDF) from BrightPath to the Finance mailbox for audit trail.

Neha — please confirm with Claire that BrightPath will either provide the attestation or accept the cost-share terms. Rishi / Marissa, proceed to book once Concur request is submitted and finance confirms the charge code.

Aditya Rao
VP, Sales Operations
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Claire Hastings <chastings@brightpath.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Nov 2025 14:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite confirmation + travel exception request

Neha & team — thank you and please pass along our appreciation to Aditya. BrightPath will provide a one-paragraph medical attestation from David's physician and will confirm acceptance of the 50/50 hotel split.

I will upload the attestation to the Concur request and send a calendar update for travel details once tickets are booked. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Claire
